scope: Oracle reconstruction of all accepted observed G31 leg samples, not a generative result or planned-map decoder validation

method.spatial_path: 2049 equal arc-length points from observed target XY; float64
method.progress: 257 samples of target cumulative arc at uniform relative observation times, normalized by observed arc; float32 as in G22
method.clock: Actual first-to-last stored FCD timestamps; no invented event-boundary coordinates
method.physical_clock: Cumulative XY chord arc interpolated at integer seconds relative to first observation; last fractional second excluded from speed summaries
method.steady: v[1:] >= .3 m/s and abs(diff(v)) < .5 m/s, counting qualifying one-second transitions
method.stop: v < .3 m/s; stop episodes count all runs including initial stop; rate per covered whole minute
method.lag4: mean(abs(v[4:] - v[:-4])); not divided by four
method.short_support: All legs retained for geometry. Speed/stop need >=1 whole second; acceleration/steady >=2; lag4 >=5. Unsupported values counted, not silently dropped
method.constant: Observed XY arc <= 1e-12 m: constant path and uniform [0,1] progress; exact stationary representation diagnostic, not motion-normalization training readiness
method.path_only_control: Same oracle path evaluated at original observed normalized cumulative arc before 257-point time compression
method.aggregation: Per-leg distributions; repeated legs of one parent remain dependent. No confidence intervals or different-unit total scores

limits: The target-derived path is unavailable in genuine synthesis. Errors are optimistic interface diagnostics, not a mathematical lower bound for all other path choices.
Zero observed endpoint error is by construction and does not establish exact event arrival coordinates or planned-route validity.
Accepted event coverage does not imply topology, permissible source conditions, or generative readiness.
This one pilot reuses public demand and is not independent generative evaluation. No model is fit or selected.
No threshold for declaring representation adequate is fitted to these results; long-tail and per-class errors must be considered.
